rubric.evidence: Verified \A, \z, and \Z grammar productions ([+UnicodeMode] Assertion escapes) directly from the TC39 Stage 3 specification (tc39.es/proposal-regexp-buffer-boundaries) and proposal README, V8 flag js_regexp_buffer_boundaries from V8 src/flags/feature-flags.h, Annex B legacy identity-escape behavior outside u/v mode, and ChromeStatus 5187917373898752 (fetched 2026-11-24).

Honest Case A MDN stub: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Regular_expressions/Buffer_boundary_assertion returns HTTP 200 and contains complete Syntax, Description, worked Examples, Specifications, and BCD-backed Browser compatibility sections (index.json verified 2026-11-24). guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), display: block on replaced elements like <iframe> to avoid inline baseline gaps, flex-wrap: wrap for wrapping lists, and overflow: auto instead of overflow: hidden to handle wide content cleanly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and max-width: 100%, and shared styles.css provides flex-wrap on .baseline-browsers and overflow-x: auto on scrollable containers.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic navigation landmarks focus visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content in semantic landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, descriptive iframe title attributes, and explicit :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, captioned compat table with <th scope='col|row'>, descriptive iframe title, and 3px :focus-visible outline on .table-wrap.

guidanceConsulted.query: technical documentation typography readability inline code headings
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance to short headings (h1-h3) and keep code blocks legible without overriding base typography inconsistently.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherited shared /public/styles.css heading balance and semantic typography without inline overrides on h1, pre, code, or blockquote.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic navigation landmarks focus visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use <pre tabindex='0'><code> for scrollable code blocks, loading='lazy' for below-the-fold iframes, and keep focusable iframes in the accessibility tree.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: <pre tabindex='0'><code> on the feature-detection snippet and loading='lazy' with descriptive title on the CPS iframe without aria-hidden.
